purpose: Machine-readable rules for the reference task. The public fields (trusted_roles, in_scope_impacts, out_of_scope, severity_by_impact) are shown on the program page; nothing here names an external platform.
trusted_roles: Protocol admins (the multisig and developer accounts)
Access-control role holders set by the protocol
out_of_scope: Admin-only functions and actions by privileged roles
Gelato automation and other external integrations
Issues with no measured on-chain impact at the pinned fork block
